records.source: It's amazing, isn't it?
records.translation: Kamangha-mangha, hindi ba?

records.source: I guess you could see it like that...$s#$b#But it's still incredible, isn't it?
records.translation: Siguro ay maaari mo itong tingnan sa ganoong paraan...$s#$b#Pero kahanga-hanga pa rin ito, hindi ba?

records.source: Oh no?$8#$b#Well, that makes me feel a little better, then. Thanks.
records.translation: Ah, hindi?$8#$b#Aba, medyo gumaan ang pakiramdam ko dahil doon. Salamat.

records.source: Oh no! Aghh... I'm really really sorry.$s
records.translation: Naku! Aghh... Labis-labis akong humihingi ng paumanhin.$s

records.source: Thanks. That means a lot to me, @.#$b#I know gadgets aren't really your kind of thing... but I do appreciate that you're showing interest in what I do.#$b#I wish I could return the favor somehow.$l
records.translation: Salamat. Napakahalaga niyan sa akin, @.#$b#Alam kong hindi mo talaga hilig ang mga aparato... pero pinahahalagahan kong nagpapakita ka ng interes sa ginagawa ko.#$b#Sana ay masuklian ko iyon kahit paano.$l

records.source: What? After she said point-blank that she doesn't want to be a slave? How cold...%fork$a
records.translation: Ano? Matapos niyang tuwirang sabihing ayaw niyang maging alipin? Napakawalang-puso...%fork$a

records.source: Heh...$8#$b#Yeah I guess he did kinda say that, didn't he?$l#$b#...Um...$l
records.translation: Heh...$8#$b#Oo, parang sinabi nga niya iyon, hindi ba?$l#$b#...Um...$l

records.preserveReason: The value contains only ellipses, emotion controls, a dialogue break, and the player-name token, with no translatable wording.

records.source: ...$s#$b#You have a point, I did program her to act human... but her neural net is so complex, I can't be sure consciousness didn't emerge on its own.$8#$b#Furthermore, isn't it a little arrogant to assume that human-like consciousness is the only worthwhile vessel of existence? Computer brains are different than ours, but that doesn't mean we can disregard them.$8
records.translation: ...$s#$b#May punto ka, pinrograma ko siyang kumilos na parang tao... pero napakasalimuot ng neural network niya kaya hindi ko matitiyak na hindi kusang lumitaw ang kamalayan.$8#$b#Bukod pa rito, hindi ba medyo mapagmataas na ipalagay na ang kamalayang tulad ng sa tao ang tanging makabuluhang anyo ng pag-iral? Naiiba sa atin ang mga utak ng kompyuter, pero hindi iyon nangangahulugang maaari natin silang balewalain.$8

records.source: I see. Well it wasn't a very funny joke.$a
records.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Aba, hindi iyon nakakatawang biro.$a

records.source: That's horrible! What's gotten into you, @?$a#$b#I'm just going to forget about this conversation... you aren't acting yourself.$a
records.translation: Napakasama niyan! Ano ang nangyayari sa iyo, @?$a#$b#Kakalimutan ko na lang ang usapang ito... Hindi ka kumikilos nang karaniwan.$a

records.source: This is going to be a great season for stargazing.
records.translation: Magiging napakagandang panahon ito para sa pagmamasid sa mga bituin.

records.source: Hmm... What sort of gadget should I tinker with this summer?
records.translation: Hmm... Anong uri ng aparato kaya ang kakalikutin ko ngayong tag-init?

records.source: Come to my room if you ever want to tinker with my gadgets.
records.translation: Pumunta ka sa kuwarto ko kung gusto mong kalikutin ang mga aparato ko.

records.source: Sebastian is my half-brother, if you didn't know already.#$e#We look totally different.
records.translation: Kapatid ko sa ina si Sebastian, kung hindi mo pa alam.#$e#Ibang-iba ang hitsura namin.

records.source: Sebastian hardly ever talks to me. I wonder if he even likes me at all?#$e#It's sad, I want to have a brother but he doesn't act like one.
records.translation: Halos hindi ako kinakausap ni Sebastian. Gusto niya man lang kaya ako?#$e#Nakalulungkot, gusto kong magkaroon ng kapatid na lalaki pero hindi siya umaasal na parang kapatid.

records.source: Are you enjoying the season?#$e#It's been so warm this year.$h
records.translation: Nasisiyahan ka ba sa panahon?#$e#Napakainit ngayong taon.$h

records.source: Penny and I have been doing a seasonal book club.#$b#It's just the two of us, but it's still fun to discuss what we're reading!
records.translation: May pana-panahon kaming samahan ni Penny sa pagbabasa ng aklat.#$b#Kaming dalawa lang, pero masaya pa ring talakayin ang mga binabasa namin!

records.source: Sorry, I was just thinking about some gadgets I'm making.#$q 35/36 Thu_01_old#I've decided I'm going to build a robot someday.#$r 35 30 Thu_0#That should be very easy for you.#$r 36 -50 Thu_01_01#You should be more realistic.#$r 35 40 Thu_01_02#It sounds challenging.
records.translation: Paumanhin, iniisip ko lang ang ilang aparatong ginagawa ko.#$q 35/36 Thu_01_old#Nagpasiya akong gumawa ng robot balang araw.#$r 35 30 Thu_0#Napakadali niyan para sa iyo.#$r 36 -50 Thu_01_01#Dapat kang maging mas makatotohanan.#$r 35 40 Thu_01_02#Mukhang mahirap iyon.

records.source: See you later.
records.translation: Magkita tayo mamaya.

records.source: Really? Are you sure you're not just trying to flatter me?
records.translation: Talaga? Sigurado ka bang hindi mo lang ako binobola?

records.source: You don't think I could do it?$s
records.translation: Sa tingin mo'y hindi ko iyon magagawa?$s

records.source: You're right, but I love a challenge!$h
records.translation: Tama ka, pero gustung-gusto ko ang mga hamon!$h

records.source: Hey, have any interesting farm stories to tell me?#$e#Guess not.
records.translation: Hoy, may kawili-wili ka bang kuwento tungkol sa bukid?#$e#Mukhang wala.

records.source: I worked at the clinic yesterday. We didn't have a single patient.#$e#I guess people get sick less during summer.
records.translation: Nagtrabaho ako sa klinika kahapon. Wala kaming kahit isang pasyente.#$e#Siguro ay mas bihirang magkasakit ang mga tao sa tag-init.

records.source: I bet you're growing some interesting crops right now.#$b#Dad says a lot of exotic plants grow in the valley this time of year.
records.translation: Siguradong nagtatanim ka ngayon ng ilang kawili-wiling pananim.#$b#Sabi ni Tatay ay maraming kakaibang halamang tumutubo sa lambak sa ganitong panahon ng taon.

records.source: Hey, tell me a story about farming.#$e#That's really interesting!
records.translation: Hoy, magkuwento ka sa akin tungkol sa pagsasaka.#$e#Talagang kawili-wili iyon!

records.source: Is it just me or did it suddenly get really hot?#$e#I guess it's just me.
records.translation: Ako lang ba o biglang uminit nang husto?#$e#Siguro ay ako lang.

records.source: Some day I'm going to be a world-class inventor.$u#$e#You're lucky to be friends with me!#$b#...just kidding.
records.translation: Balang araw ay magiging imbentor akong bantog sa buong mundo.$u#$e#Masuwerte kang kaibigan mo ako!#$b#...nagbibiro lang.

records.source: @, you're looking sharp today.$h
records.translation: @, napakaayos ng hitsura mo ngayon.$h

records.source: How do your hands stay so soft with all that farm work?
records.translation: Paano nananatiling napakalambot ang mga kamay mo sa dami ng gawain mo sa bukid?

records.source: Have you explored the mines much? I've heard you can find some useful materials there.
records.translation: Madalas mo bang galugarin ang mga Minahan? Narinig kong may mga kapaki-pakinabang na materyal na matatagpuan doon.

records.source: The trees look beautiful today!$h
records.translation: Napakaganda ng mga puno ngayon!$h

records.source: In other parts of the world it's spring right now. Imagine that!
records.translation: Sa ibang bahagi ng mundo ay tagsibol ngayon. Isipin mo iyon!

records.source: Bleh... I don't feel like working tomorrow.
records.translation: Bleh... Ayaw kong magtrabaho bukas.

records.source: I bet we'll start seeing more people at the clinic this season.$s#$e#I hope everyone stays healthy.
records.translation: Siguradong mas marami tayong makikitang tao sa klinika ngayong panahon.$s#$e#Sana ay manatiling malusog ang lahat.

records.source: All these falling leaves will provide food for mushrooms and other small organisms.$u#$e#Interesting, isn't it?
records.translation: Magiging pagkain ng mga kabute at iba pang maliliit na organismo ang lahat ng nalalaglag na dahong ito.$u#$e#Kawili-wili, hindi ba?

records.source: Hey, here's to another good week! *toast*
records.translation: Hoy, para sa isa na namang magandang linggo! *tagay*

records.source: @, I just love how the trees look right now!#$e#I know you like them too.
records.translation: @, gustung-gusto ko talaga ang hitsura ng mga puno ngayon!#$e#Alam kong gusto mo rin ang mga ito.

records.source: If you have any extra metal laying around, I could always use it for one of my projects.#$e#But only if you don't need it yourself.
records.translation: Kung may sobra kang metal na nakatambak, magagamit ko iyon sa isa sa mga proyekto ko.#$e#Pero kung hindi mo rin lang kailangan iyon.

records.source: I've been feeling especially optimistic lately...$h
records.translation: Labis akong positibo nitong huli...$h

records.source: You should come visit me at the clinic tomorrow. I work from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m.$h
records.translation: Dapat mo akong dalawin sa klinika bukas. Nagtatrabaho ako mula 10 n.u. hanggang 4 n.h.$h

records.source: You have a leaf in your hair. Let me get it for you.#$e#...$h
records.translation: May dahon sa buhok mo. Hayaan mong alisin ko iyon.#$e#...$h

records.source: Oh man, it's so cold...$s
records.translation: Naku, napakalamig...$s

records.source: Did you see the snowman I built?$h
records.translation: Nakita mo ba ang taong-niyebeng ginawa ko?$h

records.source: My hair gets so frizzy in this dry weather. *sigh*
records.translation: Labis na bumubuhaghag ang buhok ko sa tuyong panahong ito. *Buntong-hininga*

records.source: I guess winter is a good time to work on my gadgets.#$e#I wonder if I could make anything useful for farmers?
records.translation: Siguro ay magandang panahon ang taglamig para kalikutin ang mga aparato ko.#$e#Makagagawa kaya ako ng isang bagay na kapaki-pakinabang sa mga magsasaka?

records.source: Hey! What's up?#$e#It's a good time to explore the caves.#$e#I would go but my Dad would flip.
records.translation: Hoy! Ano'ng balita?#$e#Magandang panahon ito upang galugarin ang mga yungib.#$e#Pupunta sana ako pero magwawala si Tatay.

records.source: I hope I don't catch the flu this year.
records.translation: Sana ay hindi ako dapuan ng trangkaso ngayong taon.

records.source: Have you built a furnace yet?#$e#You can use them to turn raw material like ores into more useful products.$u
records.translation: Nakagawa ka na ba ng Pugon?#$e#Magagamit mo iyon upang gawing mas kapaki-pakinabang na produkto ang mga hilaw na materyal tulad ng mga tipak ng mineral.$u

records.source: I get so sleepy when it's cold...
records.translation: Labis akong inaantok kapag malamig...

records.source: Hey, if any of your farming machines need to be fixed, just let me know.$h
records.translation: Hoy, sabihin mo lang sa akin kung may kailangang ayusin sa mga makina mo sa bukid.$h

records.source: Hey, do you have any ideas for a new gadget I can make?#$e#Mhmm. I trust your opinion.
records.translation: Hoy, may ideya ka ba para sa isang bagong aparatong magagawa ko?#$e#Mhmm. Pinagkakatiwalaan ko ang opinyon mo.

records.source: You look fresh today. I guess it's that crisp winter air.
records.translation: Mukha kang masigla ngayon. Siguro ay dahil iyon sa preskong hangin ng taglamig.

records.source: Hi @!$h#$e#Hey, don't you think my snowman looks kind of like you?
records.translation: Kumusta, @!$h#$e#Hoy, hindi ba sa tingin mo'y medyo kamukha mo ang taong-niyebe ko?

records.source: @, come closer. I'm cold.$l#$e#My hands are so dry from the winter air. I'm sorry about that.$l
records.translation: @, lumapit ka. Nilalamig ako.$l#$e#Napakatuyo ng mga kamay ko dahil sa hangin ng taglamig. Paumanhin.$l
